name: Modular Transfer
definition: The modular transfer phase uses precomputed matrices to turn source flux into multiple-scattered flux, which is then looked up by the final gather phase. It computes an approximate multiple-scattered flux Φm ≈ Φgt, where Φgt is the ground-truth flux for paths with 2 or more segments. Unlike source flux, Φm does not conceptually contain the scattering event (material term); the final gather phase includes it.
